hypotheses.V1_controls_are_angle_matched: Every learned-manifold control matches the partner direction's cosine to the native direction within 1e-5.
hypotheses.V2_partner_is_privileged_on_both_transpl: Partner replacement has lower KL than the median matched control in both directions and both evaluation halves.
hypotheses.V3_partner_beats_the_control_tail: Partner replacement is below the matched-control p10 in at least one direction on both halves.
hypotheses.V4_partner_is_better_than_deleting_the_v: Partner replacement has lower KL than deleting the leading native component in both directions and both halves.
hypotheses.V5_transplant_advantage_is_split_stable: Partner/control-median ratios differ by at most 0.25 between evaluation halves for both directions.
